summary.text: Shawn Chauncey is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 65 who has represented the district since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Shawn Chauncey was born in South Dakota, and his career experience includes working as a builder.
He succeeded Jeff Underhill in the District 65 seat and took office on January 13, 2025.
